description: Ingest new git, diff, shell, docs and (if enabled) conversation and github.com issue/PR history for a NexusMem-tracked repository into its local database. Pass pruneSource or pruneStaleShell instead to delete a dead source's nodes (e.g. the pre-hook shell scrape) rather than syncing -- dry-run unless yes is also true, since this is an irreversible full wipe of that source.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the repository root

pruneSource.description: Delete every node from this exact source (e.g. "shell:pwsh") instead of syncing

pruneStaleShell.description: Shortcut for pruneSource on shell:pwsh, shell:bash and shell:zsh at once -- the dead pre-hook scrape sources

yes.description: Confirms the delete. Without it, pruneSource/pruneStaleShell only report the matching count.

name: sync_project
title: Sync remembered history
